_about: Live's items that other services may grant (ADR-054 §3 grantors), by Live's item id. OpenVibe.Quest gives these as quest rewards: Sparkle for saying hello in chat, Hearts for a first follow, the Basic Cap for going live, Fire Name for streaming three times, Ice Name for starting a thread, Rainbow Name for improving a wiki page. OpenVibe.Games gives six for achievements (`earn` names which): a person signed in to OpenVibe gets each once.

fx_toxic.how: First Haul in Scraplandia (extract valuables to Scrap City)

fx_golden.how: Big Haul in Scraplandia (500 haul points in one extraction)

hat_cowboy.how: Haul Week in Scraplandia (2,000 haul points in a week)

fx_neon.how: First Haul in Salvage Rush (score in a round)

px_flames.how: Big Haul in Salvage Rush (five points in one round)
